# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_external_verification_submit (Action)

Submits proof of ownership for an enterprise's monitored numbers that are hosted outside Telnyx.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document_ids` (List of String) Ids of uploaded documents (Documents API) proving the enterprise owns its phone numbers hosted with another provider, for example a carrier invoice or account statement.
- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.

### Optional

- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Optional. The phone numbers hosted with another provider that the documents cover, in E.164 format. Shown to the reviewer to match the documents to your numbers; you can still add numbers that are not listed here, and each is checked on its own.
